name: Monthly Assets Depreciation List
query:
select gl.account Account, gl.credit Credit, gl.debit Debit, gl.cost_center 'Cost Center', gl.posting_date 'Posting Date', 
gl.against_voucher_type Against, gl.against_voucher Asset, a.status Status, a.gross_purchase_amount 'Gross Purchase Amount', 
a.asset_rate 'Asset Rate', voucher_type, voucher_no 
from `tabGL Entry` gl, tabAsset a 
where gl.against_voucher=a.name 
and gl.docstatus=1 and gl.is_cancelled=0 and voucher_type != "Asset Movement" and gl.account in ( 
'160030003 - Accumulated Depreciation - Computer & Accessories - BDBL', '510010062 - Depreciation-Computer & Assessories - BDBL', 
'160040001 - Accumulated Depreciation - SOFTWARE - BDBL', '510010029 - Amortization - BDBL', 
'160030002 - Accumulated Depreciation - Office Equipment - BDBL', '510010061 - Depreciation- Office Equipment - BDBL', 
'160030001 - Accumulated Depreciation - Buildings - BDBL', '510010060 - Depreciation-Buildings - BDBL', 
'160030006 - Accumulated Depreciation - Furniture and Fixtures - BDBL', '510010065 - Depreciation - Furniture and Fixtures - BDBL', 
'160030010 - Accumulated Depreciation - Electrical Equipments & Installations - BDBL', '510010069 - Depreciation - Electrical Equipments & Installations - BDBL', 
'160030004 - Accumulated Depreciation - Motor Vehicle - BDBL', '510010063 - Depreciation-Motor Vehicle - BDBL', 
'160030009 - Accumulated Depreciation - Network Equipments & Installations - BDBL', '510010068 - Depreciation - Network Equipments & Installations - BDBL', 
'160030007 - Accumulated Depreciation - Security Equipments - BDBL', '510010066 - Depreciation - Security Equipments - BDBL', 
'160030008 - Accumulated Depreciation - Other Equipment - BDBL', '510010067 - Depreciation - Other Equipment - BDBL', 
'160030005 - Accumulated Depreciation - Arts & Artefacts - BDBL','510010064 - Depreciation - Arts & Artefacts - BDBL') 
and gl.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
and gl.voucher_no not in (
    select journal_entry_for_scrap from tabAsset where disposal_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
)
and gl.voucher_no not in ( select name from `tabJournal Entry` where docstatus=1 and reverse_jv = 1 )
order by gl.cost_center, gl.against_voucher
